{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "praise_and_complaint_drivers",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "primary_concern",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Captures the topical dimension (quality, durability, functionality, design, value, service) that a review's praise/complaint is ABOUT. This is a genuine aspect-of the driver concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "quality_or_durability_judgment",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "The valence/evaluative-verdict facet (poor..excellent) on the quality/durability dimension. It is an aspect of what drives praise vs complaint, though it overlaps semantically with primary_concern's quality/durability values."
    },
    {
      "name": "problem_scope",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Characterizes the extent/severity of a problem (early_failure, immediate_failure, partial_failure). A legitimate sub-aspect of the complaint side, but it overlaps heavily with failure_pattern_or_cause."
    },
    {
      "name": "failure_pattern_or_cause",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "cause",
      "rationale": "Explicitly encodes the CAUSE of failure (material_defect, design_flaw, manufacturing_flaw). This is the underlying reason behind a complaint, i.e. an external/causal explanation, not a constitutive part of the driver concept itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "usage_expectation_alignment",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "The expectation-vs-reality facet (falls_short, exceeds_expectation, misrepresented) is a genuine aspect of what drives praise/complaint."
    },
    {
      "name": "satisfaction_outcome",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "restatement",
      "rationale": "high_satisfaction / regret / would_not_recommend is the OUTCOME/summary sentiment the drivers produce, i.e. the whole restated, not a constitutive part of the drivers."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [
    "primary_concern",
    "quality_or_durability_judgment",
    "problem_scope",
    "usage_expectation_alignment"
  ],
  "non_facet_columns": [
    "failure_pattern_or_cause",
    "satisfaction_outcome"
  ],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.4,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "Several columns are constitutive facets of the driver concept: primary_concern (topic dimension), quality_or_durability_judgment (evaluative verdict), problem_scope (severity), and usage_expectation_alignment (expectation gap). However two columns fail the meronymy test: failure_pattern_or_cause encodes the CAUSE behind complaints (causal, not part-of), and satisfaction_outcome restates the overall result the drivers produce rather than a part of them. Mutual exclusivity is weak: primary_concern already contains quality/durability/expectation_mismatch values that are re-expressed by quality_or_durability_judgment and usage_expectation_alignment, and problem_scope overlaps failure_pattern_or_cause. Exhaustiveness is moderate: product-related praise/complaint drivers (quality, durability, expectation, functionality) are covered, but non-product drivers such as service, delivery/shipping, price/value, and packaging are only marginally represented, leaving important constitutive aspects thin."
}
